title: Vercel UI SDK: Headless definePrimitive Kernel, Asleep Lazy Wake-Up & Provisional Render Isolation
summary: Headless UI primitives in @ui-sdk/core isolate state transitions, controlled option syncing, and slot attributes from framework renderers via definePrimitive. Instances configured with asleep stay dormant (skipping api construction and DOM bind callbacks) until the first handled interaction or instance.api read, while part(slot, props, rendering) fences speculative renders (React StrictMode / concurrent retries) until commit, and renderVersion ignores high-frequency live key updates.

references.description: definePrimitive contract: state, live, asleep, sync, controlled, commits, api, slots, and agent metadata
part(slot, props, rendering) provisional render isolation preventing uncommitted renders from mutating committed handlers
wake() and owner.sleeping deferring api construction and DOM bind until first event or api access
schemaOf WeakMap memoization and renderVersion counter skipping live-only state updates
